description: This file implements post-restart orphaned session recovery for subagent sessions in a gateway system. It scans for orphaned sessions with aborted last runs, sends resume messages, and manages retries with exponential backoff.

methods.name: buildResumeMessage
methods.description: Constructs a resume message for an orphaned subagent, including task details and optional last human message.

methods.name: extractMessageText
methods.description: Extracts text content from a message object, handling different content formats.

methods.name: resumeOrphanedSession
methods.description: Sends a resume message to an orphaned session via the gateway and attempts to remap the run ID.

methods.name: recoverOrphanedSubagentSessions
methods.description: Scans for orphaned sessions with active runs and aborted last runs, then attempts to resume them.

methods.name: scheduleOrphanRecovery
methods.description: Schedules recovery attempts with exponential backoff retries after a gateway restart.
